concepts.title: Picture Reading
concepts.description: Developing the ability to interpret and describe visual scenes or illustrations to predict the context of a story before reading the text.
key_ideas: Observing visual details
Predicting story themes from images
Connecting pictures to text

concepts.title: Reading Aloud with Punctuation
concepts.description: Learning to read sentences aloud with appropriate pauses and intonation based on punctuation marks like full stops, commas, and question marks.
key_ideas: Pausing at full stops
Changing tone for questions
Reading with expression

concepts.title: Understanding Words in Context
concepts.description: Deducing the meaning of unfamiliar words by analyzing the surrounding words, sentences, and illustrations within a passage.
key_ideas: Using sentence clues
Guessing meaning without a dictionary
Identifying synonyms in text

concepts.title: Identifying Characters and Setting
concepts.description: Recognizing and describing the 'who' (characters) and the 'where' (setting) within a story or poem.
key_ideas: Naming main characters
Describing character traits
Identifying the location of the story

concepts.title: Sequencing Story Events
concepts.description: Arranging the key events of a story in the correct chronological order to demonstrate understanding of the plot flow.
key_ideas: Identifying beginning, middle, and end
Ordering jumbled sentences
Retelling the story flow

concepts.title: Nouns — Naming Words
concepts.description: Nouns — Naming Words — part of the chapter on Basic Grammar.
key_ideas: Core principles of nouns
Step-by-step problem solving for nouns
Real-world applications of nouns

concepts.title: Verbs — Action Words
concepts.description: Verbs — Action Words — part of the chapter on Basic Grammar.
key_ideas: Core principles of verbs
Step-by-step problem solving for verbs
Real-world applications of verbs

concepts.title: Singular and Plural
concepts.description: Singular and Plural — part of the chapter on Basic Grammar.
key_ideas: Core principles of singular and plural
Step-by-step problem solving for singular and plural
Real-world applications of singular and plural

concepts.title: Pronouns — Replacing Nouns
concepts.description: Learn about words used in place of naming words to avoid repetition in sentences.
key_ideas: Using 'He', 'She', and 'It' for singular nouns
Using 'We' and 'They' for plural nouns
Using 'I' and 'You' in conversation

concepts.title: Adjectives — Describing Words
concepts.description: Understand how to use words that describe the quality, color, size, or shape of a noun.
key_ideas: Describing how something looks, feels, or tastes
Identifying colors and numbers as adjectives
Placing describing words before naming words

concepts.title: Articles — A, An, and The
concepts.description: Learn the rules for using 'A', 'An', and 'The' before nouns based on vowel and consonant sounds.
key_ideas: Using 'An' before words starting with vowels (a, e, i, o, u)
Using 'A' before words starting with consonants
Introduction to 'The' for specific items

concepts.title: Prepositions — Position Words
concepts.description: Identify words that tell us where a person, animal, or thing is located.
key_ideas: Common position words: in, on, under, behind
Understanding relationship between objects
Answering 'Where' questions

concepts.title: Basic Punctuation and Capitalization
concepts.description: Learn the fundamental rules for starting and ending sentences correctly.
key_ideas: Starting sentences with a capital letter
Capitalizing special names (Proper Nouns) and 'I'
Ending statements with a full stop (.)

concepts.title: Picture Composition
concepts.description: Picture Composition — part of the chapter on Writing.
key_ideas: Core principles of picture composition
Step-by-step problem solving for picture composition
Real-world applications of picture composition

concepts.title: Writing Short Paragraphs
concepts.description: Writing Short Paragraphs — part of the chapter on Writing.
key_ideas: Core principles of writing short paragraphs
Step-by-step problem solving for writing short paragraphs
Real-world applications of writing short paragraphs

concepts.title: Jumbled Sentences
concepts.description: Learning how to rearrange mixed-up words to form meaningful and grammatically correct sentences.
key_ideas: Identifying the subject and action in a group of words
Placing capital letters at the beginning
Ensuring the sentence ends with a full stop or question mark

concepts.title: Story Sequencing
concepts.description: Arranging a set of sentences or pictures in the correct order to tell a logical story.
key_ideas: Identifying the beginning, middle, and end of a story
Understanding chronological order
Linking events logically

concepts.title: Completing Stories
concepts.description: Using hint words or pictures to fill in the blanks and complete a short narrative.
key_ideas: Using context clues to select the right words
Maintaining the flow of the story
Using vocabulary words from a help box

concepts.title: Writing About Myself
concepts.description: Composing simple sentences to introduce oneself, describing personal likes, dislikes, and family.
key_ideas: Stating name, age, and class clearly
Describing hobbies and favorites
Structuring personal information into a list or paragraph

concepts.title: Writing Simple Notes
concepts.description: Drafting very short, functional messages such as thank-you notes or invitations.
key_ideas: Addressing the receiver (Salutation)
Writing a clear, brief message body
Signing off correctly

concepts.title: Opposites (Antonyms)
concepts.description: Opposites (Antonyms) — part of the chapter on Vocabulary Building.
key_ideas: Core principles of opposites (antonyms)
Step-by-step problem solving for opposites (antonyms)
Real-world applications of opposites (antonyms)

concepts.title: Rhyming Words
concepts.description: Rhyming Words — part of the chapter on Vocabulary Building.
key_ideas: Core principles of rhyming words
Step-by-step problem solving for rhyming words
Real-world applications of rhyming words

concepts.title: Animal Homes and Sounds
concepts.description: Learning specific vocabulary words associated with animals, identifying the unique names for their habitats and the sounds they produce.
key_ideas: Matching animals to their specific homes (e.g., Lion - Den)
Identifying animal sounds (e.g., Dog - Barks)
Expanding nature-related vocabulary

concepts.title: Synonyms (Same Meaning)
concepts.description: Identifying words that have the same or very similar meanings to expand word choice and understanding.
key_ideas: Words with identical meanings (e.g., happy and glad)
Using different words to describe the same object
Improving descriptive language

concepts.title: One and Many (Singular and Plural)
concepts.description: Understanding how to change words to show quantity by transforming singular nouns into plural nouns.
key_ideas: Concept of one vs. many
Adding 's' to simple words (e.g., cat -> cats)
Adding 'es' to words ending in s, x, ch, or sh (e.g., box -> boxes)

concepts.title: Compound Words
concepts.description: Combining two distinct smaller words to create a new word with a specific meaning.
key_ideas: Joining two words (e.g., Sun + Flower = Sunflower)
Understanding that the new word relates to its parts
Breaking down long words into smaller known words

concepts.title: Basic Homophones
concepts.description: Distinguishing between words that sound exactly the same but have different spellings and meanings.
key_ideas: Same sound, different spelling (e.g., see vs. sea)
Same sound, different meaning (e.g., two vs. to)
Using context to choose the correct word
